name: Exact Parameters and Minimality of Cyclic-Arc Obstructions
statement: For every $n\ge5$, $\mathcal A_n$ is an ample partial cube with $3n+1$ vertices, VC dimension two, and isometric dimension $n$. It is periphery-free, while every proper pc-minor is cover-recursively peripheral. Hence $\mathcal A_n$ is an ample forbidden pc-minor for the cover-recursively peripheral class; $\mathcal A_5=\mathcal P_5$.
proof: The shattered supports are the empty set, all $n$ singletons, and exactly the $2n$ coordinate pairs at cyclic distance one or two; explicit edges and squares strongly shatter all of them, while no triple is shattered. Opposing witnesses make the two projected sections incomparable in every coordinate. A zero section is the path-interval family $\mathcal J_{n-1}$; a one section peels by two pendant deletions to a square; and the contraction has a peripheral step with path site and base $\mathcal J_{n-2}$. Rotation handles every coordinate, proving pc-minimality.
